title: Secure but Broken? Deployment-Validated Evaluation of LLM Security Repairs for Kubernetes (replication package)
description: Replication package for the study 'Secure but Broken? Deployment-Validated Evaluation of LLM Security Repairs for Kubernetes'. Every LLM repair of a Kubernetes security misconfiguration is deployed on a fresh cluster and judged by seven gates (scanner rules, new findings, dry run, readiness, functional journeys, load test, security intent with runtime probes). Contains the pre-registered protocol, decision log, cases, harness, analysis scripts, paper sources and the systematic literature review. Account-specific values are replaced by placeholders.
